NarSil 1.4.0-478-gb0f2fead5 seed catalog
Seeds 501 to 600, levels at 50 ft to 600 ft, 3 visits each (v1 is the first level made at a depth, v2 the second, ...)
A seed gives the same levels only on the same game, version and data.  Each level is listed as for
a character diving straight down, with nothing found yet and no unique dead; levels with nothing
notable are left out.  An artefact can exist once per game, so the first one you see is the real one.
  item (x,y)   an artefact, ego item or out-of-depth item      forge (x,y)   a forge
  chest (x,y)  what is in a chest (only the notable things)    vault NAME    a greater vault
  boss NAME    a unique, with what it carries and drops          mon NAME      an out-of-depth monster
A weapon or bow shows its weight, which is rolled for each one: Strength adds damage sides up to the
weight in pounds, and lighter weapons score critical hits more often.
After " = ": what the item gives you (modifiers, sustains, resists, slays, abilities); "bad:" its drawbacks.
Under "If a boss is killed earlier": the other levels of that seed generated again with that unique dead
and its loot (artefacts included) already made; - is what is gone, + what is new.
